delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each receiving party shall protect the other party’s confidential information for three years from the date of disclosure. This obligation survives expiration or termination of this Agreement. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
